purpose: Teach: 無理矢理/ナンパ/いいかげん/持ち合わせ/バリエーション/この先/貰う/アイスクリーム

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、無理矢理人を誘うなよ
lines.en: Riku, stop forcing people to do stuff with you.
lines.style: Exasperated but affectionate. Quick clip on the opening. Doesn't wait for agreement. The tone of someone used to calling out a friend's nonsense mid-stride.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、駅前でナンパされたろ?桜
lines.en: Weren't you the one getting hit on at the station? Sakura.
lines.style: Playful jab. Light, almost singsongy on 「ナンパされた」. Leaning back in confidence. The teasing that only works between close friends.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、いいかげん、宿題やれよ
lines.style: Flat, exasperated. No room for negotiation. A small sigh built into the opening. The voice of someone repeating herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、今日、現金の持ち合わせある?桜
lines.en: Do you have any cash on you today? Sakura.
lines.style: Casual curiosity. Slight lift at the end like he's gauging her reaction. Relaxed, no pressure. The way you ask a friend a small favour.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の文化祭プラン、バリエーション少ないぜ
lines.en: Riku, your festival plan needs way more variety.
lines.style: Dry, knowing smirk in the voice. Leans into the critique like she's been thinking about it. Not mean—constructive, but delivered with teeth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、この先、進路どうするんだ?桜
lines.en: So what's your plan for after high school? Sakura.
lines.style: Gentler than his teasing moments. A real question underneath. Waiting—not pushing. The opening steady, like he's choosing his words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ぼくから貰うことになるぜ、手紙, 本気で
lines.en: Riku, you're going to end up getting a letter from me. Serious.
lines.style: Quiet, almost vulnerable admission. A small laugh underneath trying to soften it. Trailing-off slightly on "serious" like she's giving him a moment to catch the weight of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで頑張ったらアイスクリーム奢ってやるぜ、桜
lines.en: If you do well on the test, I'll buy you ice cream. Sakura.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate promise. Solid confidence in the offer. Not proud—just the kind of support friends give without ceremony. Slight brightness on 「アイスクリーム」.
